item.title: Pantograph 1.2.1
item.description:
New

  • Fill in PDF forms from scripts and AI agents. The `pantograph` command and its MCP tools can now fill a PDF's form fields by name, find a label such as "Name:" on a page and write beside it, add text boxes (one or many, sitting on a printed line if you like), list and remove mistakes, and flatten a finished form before it's sent. Agents get the page picture straight back from `render`, and step-by-step instructions when they connect.
  • Downloads are now a disk image. Open Pantograph-1.2.1.dmg and drag Pantograph onto Applications.
  • Fix and Reopen. If macOS runs Pantograph from a temporary copy that can't update itself (which can happen when an app downloaded from the internet wasn't moved into Applications with Finder), Pantograph now explains and offers to fix it with one click.

Fixed

  • Letter-spaced text boxes drew sideways on PDF pages that are turned 90°, 180° or 270°. They now stay upright like any other text.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.2.1.dmg, open it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
